reader.requirement: An RD with the GLOBAL clause makes its LINE-COUNTER and PAGE-COUNTER global names, referable (read and, for PAGE-COUNTER, altered) from every program the declaring program contains; an RD without GLOBAL leaves them local.

edition-consulted.switches: the qualification rule a counter diagnostic cites (§1985:IV.4.3.8.1 SRL2.9/SRL2.10 vs §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR9/SR10); the resolution is the same code

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectLevel in CounterResolver.cs, SymbolTable.Reports.cs, ReportScope.cs: ReportOf and InheritReport consult the edition only through Cite for message text
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1c27 covers reading and a sum counter; the probes add a non-GLOBAL report refused in the contained program, PAGE-COUNTER altered from the contained program, and an RD in a contained program

probes.expected: contained program reads unqualified LINE-COUNTER and PAGE-COUNTER OF R1 of the container's GLOBAL report (its only visible report), alters PAGE-COUNTER and sum counter T OF LN1, and the container sees the same registers

probes.printed: COBOL2145 on T OF R1 OF RPF, T OF LN1 OF RPF, T OF RPF (cites §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR5); COBOL5092 on DISPLAY LN1 and MOVE LN1 (cites §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR10d); COBOL2729 on unqualified LINE-COUNTER with two reports; COBOL2729 on LINE-COUNTER OF R2 and PAGE-COUNTER OF R2 in the contained program (R2 not GLOBAL); COBOL1757 GENERATE D2
probes.expected: a qualifier above the report-name refused (SUM SR5); a format 2 data-name used other than to qualify a sum counter refused (SR7); a non-GLOBAL report's counters unknown in a contained program (X.4.4.4 GR1)

probes.printed: I LC=03 / I PC=01; rdglob.rpt lines 'AB5' and 'AB6'
probes.expected: RD in a contained program with GLOBAL written between CODE and PAGE (§1985:XIII.3.5.3 SR2: order immaterial) accepted; the CODE clause's Report Writer semantics applied; its counters global to the program it contains

citations.check: OK  §1985:X.4.4.4 GR1  (python scripts/spec/cite.py --check "§1985:X.4.4.4 GR1" "the special registers LINE-COUNTER and PAGE-COUNTER are global names")
OK  §1985:XIII.3.5.3 SR3  (python scripts/spec/cite.py --check "§1985:XIII.3.5.3 SR3" "Report-name-1 is the highest permissible qualifier")

reader.notes: RPTI reads unqualified LINE-COUNTER (04) and PAGE-COUNTER OF R1, moves 9 to PAGE-COUNTER and the container sees PC1B=09; LINE-COUNTER OF R2 and PAGE-COUNTER OF R2 (R2 not GLOBAL) are refused in the contained program. A write to LINE-COUNTER is refused (COBOL2197, §1985:XIII.1.2.3), which is the Report Writer rule, not this one.

refuter.evidence: lc1.cob (outer LC1O: FD RPF GLOBAL, RD R1 GLOBAL PAGE LIMIT 20; middle LC1M; INDIRECTLY contained LC1I with its own non-GLOBAL RD RB whose detail line SOURCEs LINE-COUNTER OF R1, PAGE-COUNTER OF R1 and unqualified LINE-COUNTER; procedure MOVE LINE-COUNTER OF R1, LINE-COUNTER OF RB, MOVE 7 TO PAGE-COUNTER OF R1): --std 85 EXIT 0, 'I LC-R1=02 / I LC-RB=03 / I PC-R1=07' and lc1i.rpt '02 01 01 / 02 01 02 / 02 01 03': R1's counters are global names two containment levels down, readable in a contained program's own Report Section SOURCE clause and in its Procedure Division, PAGE-COUNTER alterable there; the unqualified LINE-COUNTER inside RB's entry is RB's, as §1985:XIII.3.5.6 SR3's second paragraph implies. lc2.cob (same with unqualified LINE-COUNTER and PAGE-COUNTER in LC1I's Procedure Division): EXIT 0, 'I LC-RB=03 / I PC-R1=01': both bind LC1I's own RB. This rests on a reading: §1985:XIII.3.5.6 SR3 ('If more than one LINE-COUNTER exists in a program, LINE-COUNTER must be qualified') is read as counting the counters of the reports the program itself describes, so the inherited R1's counter does not make LC1I's unqualified reference ambiguous; the stricter reading would refuse lc2, the binding to the container's R1 would be wrong under both, and the compiler does neither wrong thing. This is SR3's question, not X.4.4.4 GR1's. The reader's rptref already shows a non-GLOBAL RD's counters refused in a contained program. No probe overturned. Citations: OK §1985:X.4.4.4 GR1 ('the special registers LINE-COUNTER and PAGE-COUNTER are global names'); OK §1985:XIII.3.5.6 SR3 ('If more than one LINE-COUNTER exists in a program').
